name: Ashwin Kumar Uppala
description: Ashwin is Head of Community at Devfolio, leading a 1M+ builder community. He spearheaded Synthesis with the Ethereum Foundation and leads partnerships at ETHDenver. An AAIF Ambassador, he has contributed extensively to Ethereum, open source, and developer communities across India and globally. Previously at GitHub, he ran Campus Experts and GitHub Octernships, and was a Hackathon Support Specialist at MLH.
